context.transcript:
Welcome back to the Channel 5 Evening News.
I'm your host, Satomi Sato, and today we're on location at the Springfield Arena.
Tonight is the final game of the basketball championship, and everyone's excited to see which team is going to take home the trophy.
I'm here, outside of the ticket office, and there's a long line of people waiting to buy tickets.
I'm going to talk to several of the attendees now to hear what they think was the highlight of the season.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎收看 Channel 5 今晚新闻。
我是主持人 Satomi Sato，今天我们在 Springfield Arena。
今晚是篮球锦标赛的决赛，每个人都很兴奋地想看看哪个队伍能捧起奖杯。
我在这里，票务办公室外面，排着长长的队伍的人们在买票。
我现在要和几位出席者聊聊，听听他们认为本赛季最精彩的部分是什么。
